title: AMap vs Google Maps in China for Tourists (2026) | ChinaEase Buddy
heading: AMap vs Google Maps in China: Which Should Tourists Use? (2026)
description: Compare AMap and Google Maps for a China trip: local place search, Chinese hotel addresses, metro exits, walking routes and practical offline backup.
quickAnswer: For getting around mainland China, prepare AMap Global as your primary local navigation option and use Google Maps as a supplementary reference where it is available. AMap offers local place search and route planning, while access to Google services and the quality or freshness of place information can vary with your connection and location. Search the hotel's Chinese name, inspect the street address and metro exit, and save the destination before leaving Wi-Fi. Always check live directions on the day; neither app replaces station signs or the venue's official entry instructions.

items: A route that looks short on a map may still include a large interchange, an overpass or a long walk around a station block.
Use each venue's own booking instructions when the visitor entrance differs from the general map pin.

contentSections.title: Set up AMap Global before your flight
items: Install the official AMap Global listing from your device's app store; review the available language and permissions on your phone.
Search your first hotel by Chinese name, full address or a pin supplied by the hotel. Save the result and a screenshot of the address.
Test a sample airport-to-hotel route and compare metro, walking and car options.
Arrange mobile data or roaming and keep a separate offline copy of the hotel address and phone number.
After landing, confirm your exact airport terminal and current exit before following the route.

contentSections.title: Why a copied Google Maps pin can fail
items: International place labels, older reviews or a traveller-shared pin may point to another branch or the wrong building entrance.
Access to Google services in mainland China varies by network and cannot be assumed from the word eSIM alone.
A translated attraction name can refer to the larger complex while timed-ticket entry is at a specific gate.
When a driver needs a destination, send the Chinese address or local map pin, then compare it with the name on your booking.
Keep the ticket confirmation and a Chinese-language address screenshot available even if the map app stops loading.

contentSections.title: Metro exits, rides and the last few hundred metres
items: At a metro interchange, check your train's final direction, platform and exit number against current station signage.
AMap's ride-hailing entry is not identical to a standalone DiDi booking. Check the provider, price, support and payment on the screen you actually use.
For a crowded station or airport, the app's generic pin may differ from the designated taxi or ride-hailing pickup zone.
When visiting the Great Wall or another out-of-town attraction, check the real entrance and return transport separately from the route estimate.

contentSections.title: A resilient navigation backup
items: Save a Chinese hotel address and current reservation offline, plus a second way to connect to the internet.
Ask hotel staff to confirm which branch, gate or station exit matches your destination.
Use street signs and official venue maps when the app disagrees with a posted closure or entrance rule.
Allow time for a wrong turn; map app directions may change with roadworks, weather and operating hours.

faqs: Is AMap better than Google Maps in China?

For local mainland routes and Chinese place names, AMap is a useful starting point. Keep any other map you like as a reference and confirm important entrances and opening information with primary sources.
Does AMap Global have an English interface?
The official international listing describes an English-language travel experience; the screens and translations available can vary by app version and device.
Can I rely on Google Maps with a travel eSIM?
Do not assume access or map detail from the eSIM label alone. Check the specific network plan and prepare AMap plus an offline address backup.
Can AMap book a DiDi ride?
Some map flows show ride-hailing options, but the provider, checkout, customer support and payment may differ from the standalone DiDi app. Check before booking.
Why does my map lead me to the wrong gate?
The general place pin can differ from the ticketed entrance. Check the attraction or venue's official gate directions and the exact address on your ticket.
